root_idea.summary: The root centers on pouring, spilling, and flowing forth.
root_idea.development: This image extends to flowing tears and rain, extracting liquid completely, bestowing property, sweeping something away, abundant speech, and movement with the force of a torrent.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole Quran-attested group is displayed under the normalized active-participle citation form.

senses.definition: Pouring down or flowing forth copiously.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, it is an active-participle description of water pouring down; the lexical usage concerns a liquid that pours or flows out abundantly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour or pour forth liquid, such as water, tears, or rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use describing liquid being released or poured out.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw all the milk from an udder.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use referring to completely extracting the milk in the udder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give someone property from one's wealth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension in which giving is pictured as pouring something out to another person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To talk much or speak abundantly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with في الكلام, بالكلام, or الكلام in the cited constructions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour or flow forth, especially of water, rain, or tears; of an eye, to flow with tears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form VII use describing liquid or tears flowing abundantly.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To pour forth speech or talk abundantly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression is used with بالكلام and presents abundant speech through the image of a torrent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To run like a torrent, with rushing speed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or expressive description of rapid, forceful movement.
A nominal description of sand in great quantity.
A noun for a single downpour or fall of rain.
A figurative usage describing speech marked by anger.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cloud pouring forth much rain.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive nominal use applied to a rain-bearing cloud.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A loquacious, garrulous, or babbling person, including one whose speech is irrational, clamorous, or excessively abundant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of abundant or torrent-like speech; the source does not establish a restriction to a particular gender or class of speaker.
A nominal description of a speaker distinguished by plentiful speech.
A lexical variant of the sand description attested under هَمِرٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or sweep something away in a mass, as by a scoop or broad sweep.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction with the object of the action.
